description: The prediction world's predictor (see scripts/gen_prediction_world.py): the held Predictor model, the candidate models in MDL order, and the prediction rule. This is the part of the agent its self-improvement loop changes.

attrs.name: motion_predictor
attrs.description: The agent's held model of how bodies move (the newborn prior: constant velocity). `mask` is the set of base models it composes (bit k = base model of rank k).

rules.name: predict_body_next
rules.comment: The agent's predictor: where each observed body will be next frame, from the held Predictor model -- a context layer the agent fitted, where its context holds; else one base model, or a composite the agent authored that uses, per body and axis, whichever of its components predicted that body best last frame.
